purpose: Curated discovery and byte verification. Not a release compiler, complete dependency closure or new experimental authority.

records.title: SDK1 milestone completion
records.scope: 20 of 20 bounded milestones at archive commit 5abf4b69. Full program 19 of 25; no release or equivalence authority.

records.title: Standalone source package validation
records.scope: Two identical source candidates, outside-game consumption and corruption controls; no binary release or new physical acceptance.

records.title: Three-engine finite turning
records.scope: Seed 23199; three engines by three arms; all nine cells. No population robustness, repeatability or formal equivalence claim.

records.title: Godot/Jolt held-out recovery
records.scope: Exact S169, retained V28 runtime, phases 72-74 and six declared cells. No cross-engine or general recovery claim.

records.title: Recovery Panel C
records.scope: Four valid worlds: two positive cells, two negative cells, zero positive pairs. Development evidence; no acceptance promotion.

records.title: R10DH original production attempt
records.scope: Worker reported 1755 steps; original reader refused R10DH_REPORT_IDENTITY. Kicked cell unopened; original attempt stays invalid.

records.title: R10DH v2 qualification
records.scope: Complete declared qualification for its exact source and dependency key. This does not itself authorize physical acceptance.

records.title: Recovery Panel E refusal
records.scope: Qualification refused; zero worlds and zero solver steps; eight unopened cells retired. No physical conclusion.

records.title: Three-engine Explorer interface
records.scope: Original isolated desktop interface validation; source of the browser poses. Development sessions are not the acceptance campaigns.

records.title: MuJoCo completed-step force measurement
records.scope: Host characterization for the declared actuator profile; see the integration comparison for observation timing. Not an engine ranking.

records.title: Timed and measured-rotation righting negatives
records.scope: Three cohorts retain 752 valid negative performance worlds. Latest: 256 worlds across 16 bodies and 16 profiles, with 184,320 decisions and 921,600 samples replayed after 134 controls. Zero eligible or invalid worlds, no upright dwell or joint-limit breaches, and 16 empty shortlists. The feedback route is verified; useful recovery, adaptation and release remain unestablished.

records.title: Fixed-pose righting geometry diagnostic
records.scope: 22,945 poses on each of 16 retained bodies across eight directions; 108,667,520 geometric configurations, 9,216 scalar witness checks and zero worlds. All 128 body/direction groups contain an uphill fixed-pose interval. This motivates multi-phase coordination work, without a dynamic-feasibility, impossibility or recovery claim.

records.title: Four-phase righting native negatives
records.scope: All 143 controls pass before each native run. The four-world route verifies capture and replay; the 256-world cohort across 16 bodies retains zero eligible or invalid worlds, no upright dwell or joint-limit breaches, and 16 empty shortlists. All 184,320 decisions and 921,600 samples replay. Every sequence reaches wind-up but no later measured rotation/contact transition. Useful recovery, adaptation and release remain unestablished.

records.title: Compact creature capture native measurements
records.scope: Both eight-world canaries pass 153 controls and independent reading. Same-run projection is exact; compact streams retain every native substep and reconstruct outcomes without claiming controller replay. Fresh streams are 75.7% smaller. Full-plus-projection/compact outer-loop timings are descriptive only. No ordinary full-capture speedup, useful recovery, adaptation or release is established.

records.title: Balanced native dynamic trajectory search
records.scope: The five-world full route and 224-world compact search each pass 159 controls. All search worlds are valid failures: zero eligible or progress leads, sixteen joint-breach worlds, and only 32 of 192 new-profile worlds with distal contact. Compact reading reconstructs 806,400 samples; it does not provide full controller replay or recovery authority.

records.title: Retained trajectory timing and actuator-response diagnosis
records.scope: Six controls pass; all 1290240 velocity commands match across 224 retained worlds. Of 3616 completed phases, 3512 time out despite close velocity tracking. Original contact and joint-violation counts match. No new worlds, full controller replay, eligibility change or causal benefit claim.

records.title: Paired body and trajectory timing comparison
records.scope: All 172 controls pass with zero worlds. Declares 224 fresh twelve-second worlds across 16 bodies, 24 original/slow schedule pairs and fresh comparators. The initial input-inventory gap and correction remain retained. No native retiming or benefit claim.

records.title: Paired retiming improves pose completion but not recovery
records.scope: 224 fresh twelve-second worlds after 172 controls: zero eligible or progress leads, 32 joint-breach worlds. Longer schedules increase pose completion and distal contact, but every nonviolating proposal trails its fresh timed comparator. The retained-motion reader matches all 2580480 velocity commands. No full compact-controller replay, adaptation or release authority.

records.title: First joint crossings retain outward commands despite inward targets
records.scope: Six controls and all 2580480 velocity-command comparisons pass across 224 retained worlds. All 32 first crossings have outward commands, 24 precede any distal contact and two saturate force. Zero new worlds; no complete controller replay or causal benefit.

records.title: Anticipatory braking with complete declaration input inventory
records.scope: All 175 zero-world controls pass. The original legacy-test input omission is retained; a later exact-byte supplement and inventory successor include all four declarations. Only inventory and its check change. Native observations remain at the original published freeze.

records.title: Joint braking removes observed crossings but does not recover
records.scope: 224 twelve-second worlds after 175 controls: 0/96 braked and 16/96 unbraked crossing worlds, but zero recovery or progress leads. Contact and rotation decrease. All 2580480 velocity commands match. The original legacy-input inventory omission is disclosed and supplemented; no qualification or complete original dependency closure.

records.title: Geometry-guided floor targets and measured-contact anchors
records.scope: All 172 controls pass with zero worlds. The native successor now verifies an eight-world full route and 128 twelve-second worlds across sixteen bodies: all 96 new-controller worlds acquire contact with zero joint violations, but zero recovery or progress leads. Inferred anchors and braking estimates do not guarantee dynamic feasibility.

records.title: All tested contact profiles reach the ground but fail useful righting
records.scope: 128 twelve-second worlds across sixteen exposed bodies after 172 controls and an eight-world full route. All 96 new-controller worlds acquire distal contact, zero joint violations, zero recovery and zero progress leads. Best gain 1.467 degrees is below the fixed five-degree requirement. Compact outcomes are reconstructed; useful leads still require fresh full-capture confirmation.

records.title: Virtual torso goals through measured contact
records.scope: All 182 controls pass with zero worlds, including 4800 exact legacy plans. The native successor now verifies a fourteen-world full route and 224 twelve-second worlds across sixteen bodies: all 128 new-target worlds acquire contact with zero joint violations, but zero recovery or progress leads. Virtual torso goals do not certify dynamic feasibility.

records.title: Torso targets improve paired rotation without qualifying righting
records.scope: 224 twelve-second worlds across sixteen exposed bodies after 182 controls and a fourteen-world full route. All 128 new-target worlds acquire distal contact, zero joint violations, zero recovery and zero progress leads. Mean peak changes from paired bases are +2.711 and +2.952 degrees. Compact outcomes are reconstructed; useful leads still require fresh full-capture confirmation.

records.title: Continuous joint reach exposes torso-target constraints
records.scope: 334 distinct bounded descriptors, 302 kinematic shapes, ten controls, 2.9 million continuous-joint reach minima, 16032 scalar checks and zero new worlds. First excluded side-roll samples are 11–19 degrees. Inward pitch reaches farther geometrically but useful torque is unproved. Retained projections have 294 bend-domain floor exclusions and zero finite-grid floor-reach misses. No dynamic or recovery qualification.

records.title: Clear contacts and useful moments differ across bodies
records.scope: 334 descriptors, 7585 poses each, 374941720 geometric pose/orientation cases, twenty controls and zero new worlds. Nonadjacent overlap and wrong-sign normal moments constrain proposals. Thirty-one bodies retain optimistic pitch-friction bounds at every sampled orientation in both directions; no force, connected trajectory or recovery qualification.

records.title: Force and momentum controllers ready for native screening
records.scope: 230 controls, 240 exact legacy plans, 24-body zero-world preflight and no new physics. A ten-world full route precedes a 240-world compact cohort. Configured forces and clear target poses do not certify actual force, trajectories or recovery.

records.title: Body-moment search yields partial rotation without recovery
records.scope: Ten full six-second route worlds and 240 fresh twelve-second search worlds after 230 controls. Twenty-nine partial-rotation leads in 22 of 24 groups; zero qualifying recoveries or joint-breach worlds. All 1,728,000 native samples reconstruct. Actual overlap occurs in the full route; broad path clearance and fresh confirmation remain pending.

records.title: Sampled-clear partial motions and faster geometry
records.scope: Zero new worlds; 367200 retained native samples and 51 initial states. Twenty-six of 29 leads and all 22 timed comparators are sampled-clear. Geometry is 9.503 times faster on paired retained inputs; full-route replay stays exact. No continuous clearance, native throughput or recovery qualification.

records.title: Measured steering and support handoff ready for native search
records.scope: 248 controls and exact legacy full replay, with zero new worlds. Thirty-six profiles span 24 bodies with three fresh comparators per body. A twelve-world full route precedes a 216-world compact cohort; progress uses a fresh selected reference and prospective sampled-path checks. No recovery or adaptation qualification.

records.title: Broad support-handoff search without qualifying recovery or progress
records.scope: 248 controls, twelve full route worlds and 216 fresh compact worlds on 24 bodies. Independent reading verifies 8640 full decisions, 43200 full samples, 311040 compact records and 1555200 reconstructed samples. Zero recoveries, joint violations or progress leads; best gain over the stronger fresh selected reference is 3.300 degrees. No controller adopted.

records.title: Retained support-release losses and guarded actuator commands
records.scope: 28 controls and zero new worlds. One full-route body, 7200 moment-controller decisions and 36000 native samples. Nineteen of 24 completed releases lose rotation; six lose about ten degrees. Separate requested torque, post-guard predictions and observed actuator force. Support-preserving changeover remains untested.

records.title: Support-preserving exchange with a declared broad search
records.scope: 254 controls and zero new worlds. Exact replay of 8640 legacy decisions and 43200 samples. Eighteen recipes across 24 bodies vary replacement limb, geometric mass-shift weighting and measured plateau duration. A twelve-world full route must cover retained support, contact dwell, transfer and fallback before 216 compact worlds. No recovery benefit or learned adaptation established.

records.title: Broad support exchange without qualifying recovery or progress
records.scope: 254 controls before each run, twelve full route worlds and 216 fresh compact worlds on 24 bodies. Full replay checks 8640 decisions and 43200 samples; compact reading reconstructs 311040 records and 1555200 samples. Zero recoveries, joint violations or progress leads. Of 144 new-controller worlds, 62 beat their fresh selected reference, with maximum gain 3.303 degrees below five. All four full-route transfers lose replacement-foot contact after 5-14 intervals and lose rotation. Cause unisolated; no controller adopted.

records.title: Replacement force requests exceed bounds during short support transfers
records.scope: 43 controls and zero new worlds. Reads 6480 exchange decisions and 32400 native samples from one full-route body. All 68 replacement-joint requests exceed force caps; entry command envelopes fit only 18-32 percent of the static request. All four entries remove the old force request. Replacement guards act later; no native transfer joint sample reaches its force cap. Legacy command diagnosis is byte-identical. No causal isolation or recovery benefit.

records.title: Force-bounded support sharing with staged unloading
records.scope: 278 safety controls and 17 diagnostic controls; zero new worlds. Historical full replay and both command diagnoses remain byte-identical. Twelve recipes vary replacement limb, torque-aware target weighting and ramp duration across 24 bodies. Twelve full route roles must cover loading and positive unloading before 192 compact worlds. No native recovery benefit or learned adaptation.

records.title: Support-sharing search without qualifying recovery or progress
records.scope: 278 controls before each run, twelve full route worlds and 192 fresh compact worlds on 24 bodies. Full replay checks 8640 decisions and 43200 samples; compact reading reconstructs 276480 records and 1382400 samples. Zero recoveries, joint violations or progress leads. Of 96 new-controller worlds, 47 beat their fresh selected reference, with maximum gain 2.962 degrees below five. One full-route transfer retains required contact for 36 intervals but loses 0.534 degrees. No paths selected for clearance checking; no controller adopted.

records.title: Support-sharing torque response and unidentified ground-force moment
records.scope: 52 controls and zero new worlds. The reader checks 8640 full-route decisions and 43200 native samples; eight sharing profiles contribute 5760 decisions and 28800 samples on one body. One 36-interval transfer loses 0.534 degrees despite 0.040 Nm mean active-joint request error. Old-foot contact ends while another foot and torso stay in contact. Of 8.858 Nm mean proposed moment, 6.588 Nm comes from force that leaves modeled joint torques unchanged. This establishes ambiguity, not actual ground force or causal failure. Three earlier diagnostic outputs stay byte-identical.

records.title: Torque-map force proposals and explicit contact requests
records.scope: 304 safety controls, including 26 new controls; zero new worlds. All 240 planned controller roles construct without physics. The full sharing-route replay remains byte-identical for 8640 decisions and 43200 samples. Eight recipes change pose scores, normal-load requests and primary-versus-all contact commands across 24 bodies. Twenty-four full route worlds must pass before 240 compact worlds. Native recovery benefit remains untested.

records.title: Torque-map route refusal and retained numerical witnesses
records.scope: 304 controls before 24 worlds. Twelve finish three seconds; twelve stop at interval 203. All 6756 recorded decisions and 33780 samples replay, without a complete route pass. Six derived scalar cases expose cancellation; the failed prepared input is unavailable. Broad search is unrun.

records.title: Stable torque-map numerical successor and failed-input retention
records.scope: 312 controls, six retained scalar refusals fixed, 6756 historical decisions and 33780 samples replay with byte-identical audits. The distinct 24-world route and 240-world broad cohort remain unrun; no native benefit or recovery qualification.

records.title: Torque-map v2 route pass and failed broad cohort with negative completed results
records.scope: 312 controls before each run. All 24 route worlds pass replay and coverage. Broad search completes 210 worlds, interrupts ten on zero-friction cone classification and leaves twenty unopened. Every one of 126 completed new-controller worlds loses to its fresh selected reference; zero recoveries or progress leads, five joint-violation worlds. No complete cohort verdict or release authority.

records.title: Geometric cone repair and solved contact reaction diagnostic
records.scope: 330 controls pass; exact failed planning memory and synthetic solved-force decoding verified. Earlier 8640 decisions and 43200 samples reproduce the v2 audit bytes. The 36-world contact diagnostic remains unrun; no recovery or adaptation benefit established.

records.title: Solved contact reactions and numerical fallback native route
records.scope: 330 controls and 36 three-second full worlds pass. All 12960 decisions and 64800 native samples replay with independent solved-force decoding and free-root balance. Body 21 reaches fallback; no recovery or controller benefit is established. Model-moment comparison remains pending.

records.title: Measured torso reaction opposes proposed foot turning
records.scope: 16 controls and retained-data comparison of all 36 route worlds. 12960 decisions and 64800 solved samples read; 8640 new-profile intervals independently aggregated. Torso reaction nearly cancels requested-foot moment on bodies 0/16; body 21 requests none. No new worlds, changed eligibility, recovery or release authority.

records.title: Studio walking stage profiler and declared matched baselines
records.scope: Complete route preflight and three timing controls pass. Four walking stages now have separate timers. Two fresh fifteen-second baselines are declared; no native speed improvement is established.
